summary: Open, free, first-come NPS campground on the Natchez Trace Parkway at milepost 385.9: 31 paved sites (pull-through and back-in), RVs to 55 ft, no hookups, flush toilets and potable water year-round, no showers or dump, open year-round, 14-night yearly limit. rec.gov has an information-only listing (259044, not reservable), confirming first-come.
